outcome.technical: Cause, read from the saved CI lines and the code: _worktrees.admin_dir returned git's forward-slash --git-dir answer on windows and every caller joined onto it natively, so refuse_unsettled/kept_where named the copy as C:/.../.git/worktrees/t\audit-advance; the tree named by manage-worktrees came from git's listing (forward) while the drive's came from state (native). ut1/ut2/ut4 additionally searched for the copy inside json.dumps(...), which escapes every backslash, so they could not pass on windows however the refusal spelled it. kr2: the brief's diagnosis is corrected here - the stop did name the tree as recorded; the failing clause was the case's own `os.path.realpath(kept) in trees_before`, because tests/test_drive_phase.py defined `_worktree_paths` twice at module level and the later definition (line ~7142, raw git spelling, no realpath) shadowed the kr2 one, so trees_before held git's forward-slash spelling (visible in the CI line). FIX: _worktrees.py gains native_spelling(path, flavour=None) - rewrites only the path module's altsep to its sep, nothing collapsed or resolved, posix (no altsep) returned as written; admin_dir(tree, run=None, flavour=None) returns its answer through it and joins with the flavour's isabs/join; kept_where(left, flavour=None) spells left and joins its numbered-file/index/git-index paths with the flavour; refuse_unsettled, tree_unsettled's could-not-ask why and read_provenance's could-not-ask basis spell the tree. drive-phase.py: unsettled_said and unmarked_kept_stop spell the tree they name through _worktrees.native_spelling. On posix every output is byte-identical (altsep None). Left unspelled, deliberately: restore_copy's own messages name the caller's tree as passed (the drive passes native paths); a new refusal naming a git-spelled path without native_spelling is caught only on a windows leg - the guide paragraph says so. TESTS: tests/test__worktrees.py - new helpers _said (joins string leaves, no JSON escaping) and _names (independent os.path.normpath normaliser); ut1/ut2 now also require the tree named in one spelling, ut4 the tree too; new case sp1 (_spelling_cases) feeds ntpath rules on any platform: native_spelling of a forward-slash admin dir joined with a backslash, admin_dir with an injected runner answering git's windows spelling, kept_where for the copy and the tombstone - every C: path in the words free of '/' and the four copy paths named natively - plus the over-fire twin, posixpath leaving a backslash in a name alone. tests/test_drive_phase.py - kr2's helper renamed _kept_listed (unique), with _one_path = normpath(realpath(p)) on both sides, and `os.path.normpath(kept) in prints[0]`. Duplicate top-level names re-scanned by AST over all four touched .py files: none left. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md: a paragraph in the _worktrees.py section. COMMANDS: `python3 tests/test__worktrees.py --selftest` before the fix exit 1, only sp1 FAIL (missing native_spelling; TypeError for flavour= on admin_dir/kept_where caught inside the case); after, exit 0, 'ALL PASS' over the suite's own tally. Mutation probe (in-process monkeypatch, tree untouched; scratchpad/sp1_probe.py): baseline PASS; admin_dir unspelled RED; kept_where unspelled RED; over-fire (every backslash rewritten) RED; identity normaliser RED; restored PASS; exit 0. Gate `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test__worktrees.py tests/test_drive_phase.py` exit 0, '2/2 files ok'. Extra observations, not gates: ruff check on the four .py exit 0; vermin -t=3.8- exit 0. Not mine and not touched: sd12 (fails on the linux stress leg too) and lw1 (tools/gate-parity.py, dash on windows - P155.39's). DEPENDANTS: .github/sweep-costs.json - still correct, no suite renamed and no block renamed; tests/test__affected_tests.py and tools/affected.py - still correct, they use _call_name/_cases/_selftest of test__worktrees.py, unchanged; test_drive_phase.py's dependants (ci.yml, test__runner_output.py, test_run_test_gate.py, test_stamp_verification.py, reach-diff.py, affected.py) - still correct, the names they use (_actions, _bindings, _counting, _follower_cases...) are unchanged, and a repo-wide grep finds no reference to _worktree_paths/_kept_listed outside the suite (grep exit 1); importers of _worktrees.py (guard-release.py, close-phase.py, integrate-task.py, manage-worktrees.py, _evidence_io.py, drive-phase.py, run-test-gate.py, stamp-verification.py, ...) - still correct: admin_dir and kept_where gain only an optional trailing keyword, every admin_dir call passes run= by keyword, and on posix the answer is byte-identical; on windows they now get backslash paths, used only for file operations and messages; importers of drive-phase.py - still correct, only two messages' tree spelling changed, posix-identical; PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md basename dependants - still correct, a paragraph added, no heading or name changed. WINDOWS CHECK for the owner, from the repo root in PowerShell: `python tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test__worktrees.py tests/test_drive_phase.py` - expected exit 0 and the line '2/2 files ok, <N> cases'; for the cases by name: `python tests/test__worktrees.py --selftest` - expected 'PASS ut1', 'PASS ut2', 'PASS ut4', 'PASS sp1' and the 'ALL PASS' tally line, exit 0 (sd12 in test_drive_phase.py may still fail there - it is a separate fault that reddens the linux stress leg too).
